_doc: THE FOUR OVERWORLD LANDSCAPE CAMERAS, written down at last.
docs/qa/ow-land was measured on four viewpoints that were never recorded anywhere, so
the landing lane could not reproduce them and had to re-derive its own. These are the
re-derived four, pinned to ROAD STATIONS of tools/valley_map.py's ValleyField so they
survive a map edit: station 12 is the Emberbrook gate portal, 30 the open valley below
it, 150 the gorge road on the Dellhollow approach. yaw is the road tangent (the same
formula valley_export.py uses for the spawn) and pitch 0.61 is the shipped follow camera.
MEASURED WHILE CHOOSING THEM, and it is a finding, not a preference: at boom 40 the
shipped follow camera is INSIDE the canopy for road stations ~78-172 — six of nine
sampled stations photograph nothing but leaves. That is most of the walked corridor and
it belongs to whoever owns the follow camera, not to an art lane.
Expand with tools/ow_probe/land_spec.py; capture with tools/ow_probe/ow_multi.mjs.
